TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(NOT ISNULL(v_NATIONAL_ID_CLEAN) AND (LENGTH(v_NATIONAL_ID_CLEAN) = 15 OR LENGTH(v_NATIONAL_ID_CLEAN) = 14) AND (SUBSTR(v_NATIONAL_ID_CLEAN, 1, 1) = '2' OR SUBSTR(v_NATIONAL_ID_CLEAN, 1, 1) = '3'), v_NATIONAL_ID_CLEAN, NULL)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: NATIONAL_ID_FOR_MATCH

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT CUSTOMER_SK, CRM_CUSTOMER_ID, GOLDEN_CUSTOMER_ID, PHONE, EMAIL, CUSTOMER_STATUS, PLAN_SK, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE FROM DIM_CUSTOMER WHERE IS_CURRENT = 'Y'

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(v_IS_SAME_CUSTOMER_RUN = 0 AND v_HAS_DB_HISTORY = 1 AND VALID_FROM <= OLD_EFFECTIVE_START_DB, 1, 0)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_IS_ALREADY_LOADED

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(v_IS_SAME_CUSTOMER_RUN=0 AND v_HAS_DB_HISTORY=0 AND v_IS_NATID_INVALID=0 AND NOT ISNULL(CONFLICT_SK) AND CONFLICT_CRM_ID != CRM_CUSTOMER_ID1, 1, 0)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_IS_NATID_CONFLICT

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(v_IS_NATID_INVALID=1, 'INVALID_ID', IIF(v_IS_NATID_CONFLICT=1, 'CONFLICT', IIF(v_HAS_ANY_HISTORY=0, 'NEW', IIF(v_IS_ALREADY_LOADED=1, 'NO_CHANGE', IIF(IIF(ISNULL(PHONE_CLEAN),'~',PHONE_CLEAN) != IIF(ISNULL(v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_PHONE),'~',v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_PHONE) OR IIF(ISNULL(EMAIL_CLEAN),'~',EMAIL_CLEAN) != IIF(ISNULL(v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_EMAIL),'~',v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_EMAIL) OR IIF(ISNULL(CUSTOMER_STATUS1),'~',CUSTOMER_STATUS1) != IIF(ISNULL(v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_STATUS),'~',v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_STATUS) OR IIF(ISNULL(PLAN_SK1),-1,PLAN_SK1) != IIF(ISNULL(v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_PLANSK),-1,v_EFFECTIVE_OLD_PLANSK), 'CHANGED', 'NO_CHANGE') ))))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_SCD_FLAG

GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Path for the data when none of the group conditions are satisfied.
GROUP.NAME: DEFAULT1

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(SCD_FLAG1 = 'INVALID_ID', 'Invalid or missing National ID format', 'National ID already registered under a different CRM_CUSTOMER_ID: ' || TO_CHAR(CONFLICT_CRM_ID1))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: REJECT_REASON
